goal: Stop the SPA from calling telemetry/events (405) and processes/status (404) against backends that don't implement them, via a runtime feature guard (default-on; off in real-API deploy configs), eliminating the recurring console errors.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: With __APP_CONFIG__.features={telemetry:false,processStatus:false}, loading the SPA + running a calibration makes ZERO network requests to /telemetry/events, /telemetry/errors, /processes/status, and zero console errors matching those patterns.
acceptance_criteria.how_to_verify: Playwright e2e: route config.js to flags-off, navigate + trigger calibration, assert browser_network_requests has no matching URLs and browser_console_messages(onlyErrors) is clean of those patterns.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: No regression: with default flags on (mock), telemetry posts (202) and process-status polls (200) fire, and calibration trigger->status->download still works with no new console errors.
acceptance_criteria.how_to_verify: Playwright e2e default flow against mock; assert telemetry/events 202 + processes/status 200 occur and no console errors.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Unit: initTelemetry() is a no-op (no listeners/timer/queued session_start, no fetch) when telemetry flag false; behaves normally when true/unset. isProcessStatusEnabled()/isTelemetryEnabled() default true and respect __APP_CONFIG__.features.
deploy/config.dev.js and deploy/config.prod.js set features.telemetry=false and features.processStatus=false; public/config.js leaves them on (mock supports both).

acceptance_criteria.how_to_verify: npx vitest run && npm run lint && npx tsc --noEmit

tasks.desc: Add src/lib/feature-flags.ts: getFeatureFlags() reading window.__APP_CONFIG__.features; isTelemetryEnabled()/isProcessStatusEnabled() default true.
Guard initTelemetry() with isTelemetryEnabled() early-return + post() chokepoint re-check (deferred-script race); guard useProcessStatus with enabled: isProcessStatusEnabled().
Pass features through in main.tsx loadConfig() (Tauri config.json), like modules/authProvider.
Set features off in deploy/config.dev.js + deploy/config.prod.js; document on flags in public/config.js + specs/SPEC-telemetry.md.
Unit tests (vitest) for feature flags + telemetry/process-status guards.
Playwright e2e: flags-off zero-calls/zero-errors (ac1) + flags-on regression (ac2).
